South Surrey / White Rock Penthouses: streets and boundaries

items.t: This page crosses a municipal line: White Rock is its own city with its own bylaws, while South Surrey is part of the City of Surrey, so a penthouse's height and view rules depend on which side of the line the building sits.
White Rock City Hall is at 15322 Buena Vista Avenue, and the City's development portal is the address-level check for any building there.
Shared South Surrey facts: see the Sunnyside Park and King George Corridor house pages.

items.t: White Rock's Town Centre is where its apartment form concentrates: the City describes a mix of shops, offices and residences there, with new apartments being added in the Town Centre and Lower Town Centre.

blocks.text: South Surrey / White Rock Penthouses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A 2025 housekeeping amendment to Bylaw 2506 states that residential ceiling heights over 5 metres count as two floors in the gross floor area calculation — a rule that reaches double-height top-floor units directly.

The same amendment work adds semi-detached and rowhouse structures to the general regulations and prohibits mechanical equipment projecting into a required setback, both form rules for top-floor and rooftop elements.
White Rock runs two form-based permit areas a penthouse buyer will meet in the documents: the Town Centre Development Permit Area and the Waterfront Development Permit Area.

blocks.text: South Surrey / White Rock Penthouses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: City-initiated bylaw housekeeping and citywide OCP updates are not on White Rock's development portal, because they are not tied to specific addresses — a citywide height change will not appear in an address search.
White Rock planning questions go to the Planning Division at City Hall, 15322 Buena Vista Avenue, per the City's development page.

faq.q: What should I check before buying a penthouse in South Surrey White Rock?
faq.a: Read the Form B, the bylaws, the strata minutes and the depreciation report, and ask about roof, balcony and window repairs, since top-floor units are the ones exposed to them.

faq.q: What makes a penthouse different from other condos in South Surrey White Rock?
faq.a: A penthouse is a top-floor unit, usually with more floor area, higher ceilings and larger outdoor space than the units below. Strata fees and property taxes usually follow the size, so compare the full monthly cost, not just the price.
